currentContext.expansion: The Annual Report describes no new plant or capacity-addition project with a commissioning timeline. The principal expansion initiative disclosed is the entry into packaging adhesives: the Company has established process and technical know-how for water-based lamination adhesives targeting flexible packaging lamination and offset / rigid packaging lamination, with implementation currently in progress, integrated into the existing manufacturing and operational framework, and designed to be scalable for commercial production and market expansion. Investment during the year was skewed to R&D, where capital R&D expenditure rose to Rs 152.77 million from Rs 1.65 million, taking total R&D spend to 1.17% of turnover. On the energy side, efficiency work at the Gajraula SSP, Kapasan SSP and Sahibabad Adhesive plants cut power consumption by 885,191 units (KWH), saved 152.59 MT of steam and 5,278 tons of coal, with 5,278 MT of coal replaced by carbon neutral rice husk; capital investment on energy conservation equipment was stated as Nil. Structurally, the Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement on November 04, 2025 to demerge the Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited on a going concern basis.

risks.risk: Financial and operational risk across the business
risks.note: The Risk Management Committee's mandate requires a framework for identification of internal and external risks specifically faced by the listed entity, in particular financial and operational risks, together with mitigation measures, internal control systems and a business continuity plan.

Sectoral risk is named explicitly in the Risk Management Committee's risk-identification framework, and the Committee is required to review the risk management policy at least once in two years considering changing industry dynamics and evolving complexity.
The Committee's framework specifically calls out sustainability risks, particularly ESG related risks, as a category to be identified, mitigated and monitored.
Information and cyber security risks are named in the Risk Management Committee's terms of reference as risks requiring an identification framework, mitigation measures and internal controls.

risks.risk: Leverage and financing risk from delegated borrowing powers
risks.note: The Board has delegated to the Finance Committee powers to borrow up to an aggregate ` 1,250 Crores outstanding at any point of time (of which term loans not exceeding ` 500 Crores), to raise up to ` 60 Crores via commercial paper or other money market instruments, and to create mortgages/charges on movable and immovable properties up to ` 1,250 Crores to secure those borrowings.

risks.risk: Foreign exchange exposure on exports, imports and foreign currency loans
risks.note: The Finance Committee is empowered to deal with purchase or sale of spot and forward foreign exchange against exports, imports and foreign currency loans of the Company and other forex transactions including derivatives, indicating structural currency exposure.

risks.risk: Contingent exposure from guarantees, inter-corporate loans and structured trade finance
risks.note: Delegated powers include giving inter-corporate loans up to ` 5 Crores to subsidiaries, guarantees or security up to ` 20 Crores in connection with structured trade finance such as channel finance, availing factoring/payable financing/bill discounting facilities, and investments in bodies corporate up to ` 50 Crores.

risks.risk: Execution and shareholder-fairness risk in the proposed demerger
risks.note: A Committee of Independent Directors was constituted specifically to examine and recommend the draft Scheme of Arrangement for demerger and to confirm that the Scheme is not detrimental to the shareholders of the Company; the Scheme transfers the Agri Division to Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited and remains subject to completion.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited manufactures Performance Polymers & Chemicals and Agri Products in India, and is the sole manufacturer of food grade Polyvinyl Acetate (PVAc) in India and the dominant player in VP Latex.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: The Company is engaged in the manufacture of Performance Polymers & Chemicals and Agri Products comprising Single Super Phosphate and a wide range of Crop Nutrition and Crop Growth products, from plants at Gajraula and Sahibabad in Uttar Pradesh, Kapasan in Rajasthan and Savli in Gujarat. It is the sole manufacturer of food grade Polyvinyl Acetate (PVAc) in India (Gajraula) and the dominant player in VP Latex (Savli), and sells branded wood adhesives, wood finishes and agri products under well-known brands. A branch office in the Dubai Development Authority Free Zone, operating as 'Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products MEA', was set up to market products in the Middle East and other countries.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited — subsidiary: Wholly-owned subsidiary (100% shareholding) reported in Form AOC-1; reporting currency INR; no proposed dividend
- Jubilant Industries Inc. USA — subsidiary: Wholly-owned subsidiary (100% shareholding) reported in Form AOC-1; reporting currency USD, translated at an average rate of 1 USD = ` 88.3756 for FY 2025-26 and ` 94.8350 as at 31 March 2026; no proposed dividend

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:

- **Agri Products:** Single Super Phosphate (SSP), Crop Nutrition range, Crop Growth range, 'Ramban' brand

- Flexible packaging and offset / rigid packaging lamination (target applications for the new packaging adhesives business)
- Exports - the Company reported Foreign Exchange Earned during the year

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Demerge the Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited on a going concern basis under a Scheme of Arrangement approved by the Board on November 04, 2025, with shareholders of the Demerged Company receiving 1 share of the Resulting Company for every 1 share held
- Deliver on the stated promise of 'Caring, Sharing, Growing' - enhancing value for customers through innovative products and economically efficient solutions and for shareholders through sales growth, cost effectiveness and wise investment of resources
- Use R&D as a key enabler of innovation and technology absorption, with continuous process optimisation, Six Sigma across R&D and manufacturing, and margin protection through recipe optimisation and raw material qualification
- Enter value-added packaging adhesives using established know-how in water-based lamination adhesives for flexible and offset / rigid packaging lamination, scalable for commercial production and market expansion
- Focus on sustainability and environmentally friendly product development, including substituting coal with carbon neutral rice husk fuel to lower the carbon footprint
- Retain and reward key senior executives through the Employees Stock Option Plan, and focus on hiring, retaining and nurturing best talent with HR policies covering succession planning and training
- Maintain a broad-based Board with half of it Independent, a robust risk management framework, and online monitoring of internal controls spanning nearly 1,375 control assertions
- The Company did not invite or accept any deposits covered under Chapter V of the Companies Act, 2013. Details of loans, guarantees/securities and investments, along with the purpose for which they are proposed to be utilised by the recipient, are disclosed in Notes 07, 08 and 41 to the Standalone Financial Statements. Related party transactions are governed by a Board-approved RPT policy with prior omnibus approval for repetitive transactions and Audit Committee review of all RPTs; all RPTs entered into during FY 2025-26 were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis, with no material RPTs, so Form AOC-2 disclosure was not applicable. No material change or commitment affecting the financial position occurred after the close of FY 2025-26 till the date of the Report. Form AOC-1 records that there are no associate companies or joint ventures of the Company.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The Annual Report describes no new plant or capacity-addition project with a commissioning timeline. The principal expansion initiative disclosed is the entry into packaging adhesives: the Company has established process and technical know-how for water-based lamination adhesives targeting flexible packaging lamination and offset / rigid packaging lamination, with implementation currently in progress, integrated into the existing manufacturing and operational framework, and designed to be scalable for commercial production and market expansion. Manufacturing is being aligned with the packaging adhesives business plan, which the Company says enables entry into value-added packaging adhesive segments and strengthens its position in water-based adhesive solutions. Investment during the year was skewed to R&D, where capital R&D expenditure rose to Rs 152.77 million from Rs 1.65 million, taking total R&D spend to 1.17% of turnover. On the energy side, efficiency work at the Gajraula SSP, Kapasan SSP and Sahibabad Adhesive plants cut power consumption by 885,191 units (KWH), saved 152.59 MT of steam and 5,278 tons of coal, with 5,278 MT of coal replaced by carbon neutral rice husk; capital investment on energy conservation equipment was stated as Nil. Structurally, the Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement on November 04, 2025 to demerge the Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited on a going concern basis.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Sole manufacturer of food grade Polyvinyl Acetate (PVAc) in India, with a state of the art facility at Gajraula
- Dominant player in manufacturing of VP Latex, with a state of the art facility at Savli, Gujarat
- Well known brands in their segments: 'Jivanjor' and 'Vamicol' in Wood Adhesive, 'Charmwood' and 'Ultra Italia' in Wood Finish and 'Ramban' in Agri Products
- Multi-site manufacturing footprint across Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Gujarat spanning fertilizers, wood finish, sulphuric acid, latex and adhesives
- R&D as a key enabler for innovation and technology absorption, with a lab-to-pilot-to-commercialisation development cycle, Six Sigma deployment across R&D and manufacturing, and margin protection through recipe optimisation and raw material qualification
- International market access through a branch office in the Dubai Development Authority Free Zone to market products in the Middle East and other countries
- Energy and cost efficiency programme delivering power consumption reduction of 885,191 units (KWH), steam saving of 152.59 MT and coal saving of 5,278 tons in 2025-26
